!define TEST_DATA_PATH {${TEST_DATA_ROOT}\DptWorkflow}

!1 Invalid Files Detection (!-GetInvalidLintFiles-!)

|script                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
|Ensure Dpt Run In Ai Mode|${DELPHI_VERSION} !-AiSession-! Start                                                          |With Data                                                                                                 |!-DptWorkflow-!                                                                                                |
|pop fixture                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
|set working dir          |${TEST_DATA_PATH}                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
|ensure                   |run                                                                                            |cmd.exe /c echo. > Unit1.pas && echo. > Unit2.pas                                                                                                                                                                         |
|ensure                   |run                                                                                            |!-cmd.exe /c echo ^<Project xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/developer/msbuild/2003"^>^<ItemGroup^>^<DCCReference Include="Unit1.pas"/^>^<DCCReference Include="Unit2.pas"/^>^</ItemGroup^>^</Project^> > Multi.dproj-!|
|ensure                   |run                                                                                            |cmd.exe /c copy /b Unit1.pas +,, && copy /b Unit2.pas +,,                                                                                                                                                                 |
|Ensure Dpt Run In Ai Mode|${DELPHI_VERSION} !-AiSession-! !-RegisterFiles-! Unit1.pas Unit2.pas                          |With Data                                                                                                 |!-DptWorkflow-!                                                                                                |
|Reject Dpt Run In Ai Mode|${DELPHI_VERSION} Build !-Multi.dproj-!                                                        |With Data                                                                                                 |!-DptWorkflow-!                                                                                                |
|pop fixture                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
|show                     |last output                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
|ensure                   |output contains                                                                                |Lint-Ergebnis                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
|ensure                   |output contains                                                                                |Unit1.pas                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
|ensure                   |output contains                                                                                |Unit2.pas                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
|Reject Dpt Run In Ai Mode|${DELPHI_VERSION} Lint "${WDDT_ROOT}\Projects\DPT\Lint\TaifunUnitStyle.pas" Unit1.pas Unit2.pas|With Data                                                                                                 |!-DptWorkflow-!                                                                                                |
|pop fixture                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
|ensure                   |output contains                                                                                |2 Tests,	2 Failures                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
|show                     |last output                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
|Ensure Dpt Run In Ai Mode|${DELPHI_VERSION} !-AiSession-! Stop                                                           |With Data                                                                                                 |!-DptWorkflow-!                                                                                                |
